title: Roll Ball Home
description: Tilt, steer, and time ramps to guide a lively rolling sphere across clever 3D puzzle tracks all the way safely into the glowing home goal.
controls: Drag to steer the rolling ball across bridges, switches, and ramps until it reaches the home portal.

zh-CN.title: 球球要回家
zh-CN.description: 精巧解压 3D 滚动解谜球球要回家：巧妙操控弹力小球翻越机关坡道、避开陷阱沟壑，一路滚进终点小家！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动屏幕控制小球滚动方向，越过机关陷阱滚入终点传送门即可通关。
